Original manual reference. The new browser portal uses illustrative evaluation fixtures and simulated actions. It does not execute LangFair or UQLM. Open the current walkthrough. To serve locally from the repository root, run python app.py.

AI Governance Lab User Manual

A quick guide to registering an AI asset, testing it, approving a demo release and reviewing the audit evidence.

Local demonstration • LangFair and UQLM • Updated September 23 2026

Open: http://127.0.0.1:8765/. If the page is unavailable, run these commands in PowerShell and leave the window open:

cd C:\Users\lilyq\Documents\ChatGPT\FDE\governance-platform
.venv\Scripts\python.exe app.py

Use synthetic data only. The governance controls and evaluation libraries run, while answers, deployment and external actions are simulated.

1 Register an asset

  1. Scroll to Register & classify.
  2. Keep the sample metadata for a quick demonstration, or edit its JSON fields.
  3. Click Register asset.
  4. Check the asset ID and risk in the summary. Use Selected asset to switch between existing assets.

Registration does not mean approval. If information is missing, the status bar explains what to fix.

2 Test approve and deploy

  1. Click Run suite + LangFair + UQLM. The first run may take a minute.
  2. Review Evaluation evidence. Required checks must show PASS.
  3. Enter a Demo human reviewer label and click Record human approval.
  4. Click Deploy demo release.

Try a failure: click Simulate leakage failure or Test fairness / uncertainty failure. Approval should be blocked. Recover by running the passing suite, approving and deploying again.

LangFair checks counterfactual similarity; UQLM checks response consistency on synthetic fixtures. An UNAVAILABLE result means an evaluator could not run; it is not a pass.

3 Try runtime and agent controls

  1. Under Runtime & agent controls, select search, enter a benefits question and click Send request.
  2. Select propose_action and send a request. Select the new Pending action, then click Approve & simulate action.
  3. Try claims_write or Try injection to see a blocked request.

Three violations open the circuit breaker. Review the issue and deliberately redeploy the approved demo release to reset it.

4 Demonstrate reassessment

Under Material change, enter a different model version and click Apply model change. Runtime is blocked until you repeat testing, approval and deployment.

5 Review and export metrics

  1. Return to Success metrics from audit evidence.
  2. Expand Definition & scope beneath any metric. N/A means data or a denominator is missing; arrows show the desired direction.
  3. Click Download audit + metrics to save the full evidence package. Download metrics JSON saves only the report.
  4. Choose a full audit JSON file under Analyze an exported audit trail to verify and recalculate its metrics. Click Return to live metrics when finished.

Imports are read-only and limited to 2MB. Portal evaluations do not count as CI/CD execution. Metrics describe recorded demo activity.

6 Supply missing measurement data

At Measurement inputs, save eligible team IDs for adoption, record incident occurrence and detection, then select an open incident and record its resolution. Record waivers or bypasses with a reference; this does not bypass a release gate.

Quick fixes

Approval or runtime blocked: select the correct asset and repeat testing, approval and deployment. Older evidence may be outdated after a policy change.

Evaluator unavailable: start the app with the provided .venv\Scripts\python.exe, then retry.

Export rejected: choose the full audit export, not the metrics-only file. Edited or incomplete audit chains may fail verification.

Tip: use your browser’s Print command to print this manual or save it as PDF. Screenshots are embedded, so this file works offline; the application link requires the local server.
